stem: Reaction $A(g)\to2B(g)+C(g)$ is a first order reaction. It was started with pure A. Pressure of system: 160 mm Hg at t = 10 min and 240 mm Hg at t = $\infty$. Which of the following option is incorrect?

concepts: First order kinetics from pressure data

steps.text: At infinity all A is converted: $3P_0=240$, so $P_0=80$ mm Hg (option 4 correct).
